description: This file defines the Subunit entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_subunit'. It includes properties like id, name, unitId, description, and nested set positioning attributes, and implements the NestedSetInterface for hierarchical structure management.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Entity class representing a subunit within the organization, mapped to 'ohrm_subunit' table, supporting nested hierarchy via NestedSetInterface.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level in the nested hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level in the nested hierarchy.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Returns the NodeInterface instance associated with this subunit, initializing if null.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Assigns a NodeInterface instance to this subunit.
